drums.tags: Funk bass solo. Electric bass guitar with a bright, punchy tone and slight compression. The performance features a mix of percussive thumb slaps, finger pops, and rapid hammer-ons and pull-offs. The rhythm is highly syncopated with frequent use of ghost notes and dead notes to create a rhythmic, drum-like texture. The bass line utilizes the E minor pentatonic scale with occasional chromatic passing tones. The tempo is 105 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement consists of a repeating four-bar groove that evolves with melodic fills in the upper register and double-stop accents.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[solo electric bass guitar enters]
[slap and pop technique with heavy syncopation]

[Main Groove]
[percussive thumb slaps on low E string]
[high-register finger pops and slides]
[ghost notes and dead notes for rhythmic texture]

[Bridge Section]
[rapid hammer-on and pull-off sequences]
[double-stop accents]

[Outro]
[descending chromatic bass run]
[final percussive slap]
